omission_guidance.summary: NIKL explicitly accepts 선수셨다 as an optional shorter form of 선수이셨다 after a vowel-final nominal. This supports restoring the represented copula before honorific 시 rather than treating the nominal as a conjugated lexical predicate.

changed.judgment: Two new unverified nominal 들으 + omitted copula + honorific/past/modal paths, with bundled 어요 or separated 어 + 요. Existing 듣다/들다 predicate readings remain. The nominal identity and contextual honorific interpretation are unjudged.

remaining: Honorific referent suitability is not inferred from morphology or dictionary membership; nominalization composition is structural evidence only.
Other omitted prefinal families and broader copula/auxiliary attachment restrictions remain COV-020/019 work.
The short 세요 path remains bundled; this batch does not introduce generic 시어-to-세 inversion or revise lexical predicate segmentation.
Corpus checks preserve available annotated lexical alternatives. No new development gold groups are recovered, and source-backed manual cases are not held-out precision evidence.
Independent Korean-language review, fresh passage evaluation and the remaining inventory dispositions are still pending.
